records.rationale: The text describes combining customer data, human immersion in it, and distributing insights through dashboards; it gives no method for uncovering insights, so non-AI remains a weak choice.
evidence_spans: Quickly immerse yourself in the data to gain the breadth and depth of understanding required to uncover important actionable insights that would otherwise remain hidden.
insight dashboards - for decisioning, action and ongoing management
records.conflict_response: The invitation to immerse oneself in the data supports human exploration, while 'uncover ... insights' leaves the method unexplained. The dashboard/distribution wording is conventional, but does not resolve how insights arise; therefore I retain weak/forced non-AI rather than infer AI or claim supported absence.

records.rationale: The text specifies search personalization and recommendations but not how they are produced; these functions may be conventional or AI-dependent, so the best binary decision is weak non-AI.
evidence_spans: Personalize search and recommendations, to make every interaction better.
you can deliver 360  relevance across Websites, Ecommerce, Service, and the Workplace.
records.conflict_response: The text gives genuine functionality, but no implementation method that resolves whether personalization/recommendations are AI-based. Agreement between proposals cannot supply that missing evidence; I retain a forced weak negative, not a supported negative.

records.rationale: The AI-powered command-center claim is an affirmative product-specific AI signal. The text also describes a real-time website chat platform as a conventional function.
records.ai_type_rationale: The separate chat-platform description suggests conventional chat can exist, but the text does not establish whether that functionality is the meaningful core offering independent of the AI-powered command center; enabled is tentative.
evidence_spans: your AI-powered command center for consumer conversations

ai_type_evidence_spans: your AI-powered command center for consumer conversations
